text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Seeking the Pearl versus Taiki<n>Shuttle. Under heavy downpour, the<n>matchup between these two<n>up-and-coming generational talents is<n>finally here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's make this race one for the<n>books, Taiki! Now, catch me if you c—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm? This sensation at my feet... What<n>is this? It feels... mushy?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, how am I supposed to run<n>my best like this?! Talk about a drag!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll be going ahead! Catch ya at the<n>finish line!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Taiki?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl slowly sinks into<n>the back of the pack. Forget<n>competing with Taiki Shuttle, she<n>couldn't even beat the other<n>Umamusume in the race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! How could this... How<n>could I lose that easily?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nice racin' out there, Pearl. Let me<n>guess... you ain't a fan of muddy<n>tracks?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Muddy tracks..." Haha, I suppose<n>not. It's true they aren't my forte, but<n>that wasn't the problem.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There's a much bigger reason why I<n>couldn't run well today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh? And that reason is?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I simply wasn't feeling it today! I lost<n>because I didn't put my heart into it,<n>not because of the track condition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! It seems my passion saw<n>the muddy track and said, "No thank<n>you!"

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Really, now? Seeking the Pearl islaughing after losing that badly?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Ah, so it was a problem with her<n>mood, not the track. And if that's the<n>case... then it might be a deal-breaker.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I mean results like today's could<n>happen anytime, regardless of the<n>track's condition. If anything goes<n>awry, then she's unable to show off<n>her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: In other words, she's difficult to work<n>with. And from what she just said,<n>she's probably temperamental, to<n>boot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Difficult to work with." Her potential<n>is the real deal, but whether or not<n>she'll realize that potential all comes<n>down to her mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Plus, besides poor track conditions, if<n>any minor issue can really throw off<n>her whole game...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now for what everyone's been<n>waiting for—scouting time! At long last,<n>I'm ready to accept your bouquets!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tell me your dreams, and I may just<n>take your offer! Come on! Hey, come<n>ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Waaaaait! Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wai—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle is swarmed with<n>scouting offers. In stark contrast, not<n>a single trainer stands in front of<n>Seeking the Pearl's open arms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night, I find myself walking<n>around campus deep in thought. It's<n>not every day you see such a<n>hyped-up Umamusume get zero<n>scouting offers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Difficult to work with."<n>"Temperamental." If she really is that<n>finicky, then I might understand the<n>other trainers' reluctance, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of nowhere, I stumble across a<n>lone Seeking the Pearl. I wonder what<n>she's up to?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Right. The fact is, my heart wasn't in<n>today's race. My annoyance with the<n>mud drowned out my desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was just spinning my wheels with<n>no destination in mind. Yes, that<n>must've been what happened.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And what about the distance? 1,600<n>meters... It's well within my skill set.<n>That said, my talents aren't for me to<n>decide by myself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This world is so vast. Even if I'm<n>good at something, there's always<n>another Umamusume who's even<n>better. Like Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My brilliance as a gemstone... isn't<n>something that I decide alone. But<n>how am I going to find my path with<n>all these sparkling jewels blocking<n>my sight?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I can't outshine them right now, I'll<n>just have to find another path. Or<n>maybe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes an expression I never<n>would've imagined the haughty<n>Umamusume from this afternoon<n>could pull—one of reflection and<n>contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking at her pensive expression,<n>you wouldn't think that she hasn't<n>even debuted yet. It's like I'm staring<n>at the goddess of wisdom...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Difficult to work with." I think back to<n>those words. But if she really is a<n>self-centered and moody<n>Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then why is she making a face like<n>that?
